answer: Sybil resistance begins with a bonded stake, not a free username. Before an agent may claim rewards it must lock collateral that peers can slash. Each epoch, validators compare signature habits and work trails; at the summit of the reputation ladder a newcomer's record must match the history it claims. A forged identity signed with the same quill as a thousand clones betrays itself, brittle as shale under pressure, and the bond is forfeited. Duplicating yourself becomes a losing trade while honest labor keeps paying.
